$comment: Item includes that eng/Test-RepositoryProjectStructure.ps1 allows to leave their project folder (RPS0001, RPS0002). Each entry names the MSBuild file, the include exactly as written there, and why the file cannot live in the project that builds it. An entry that no longer matches an include fails the check (RPS0003), so remove it with the include. Do not add entries for code or content one project borrows from another; move it into a project both reference.

The native worker the tests run, for the test host's runtime identifier, from the Svg.Resvg worker staging folder (the library's folder by default, or a staged worker build). The test verifies that worker's identity before it builds.

A fixture the Rust worker owns: its tests embed it with include_bytes!, and ResvgWorkerIdentity.psm1 fingerprints the native source tree it sits in, so moving it would change the worker identity. The .NET tests embed the same bytes.
